40 likes, 9 comments - mombae.blogger on October 31, 2026: "The moment my kids get back from school, it’s usually a quick change, a snack and off they go again for their extracurricular classes! 😅

Between swimming, skating, football, cricket and everything else, their evenings are packed.

So I always try to keep an after-school snack ready for them — something filling and nutritious that keeps them going until dinner.

I make things like cutlets, tikkis, chaat, and other little snacks that pack in some extra nutrition.

One thing I’ve also added to their after-school routine is @our.littlejoys Nutrimix 7+. It’s a milk mix for children made with ingredients like ragi, bajra, almonds and walnuts, naturally sweetened with jaggery and dates. Two scoops provide 9g of protein, along with essential vitamins and minerals like calcium, vitamin A, vitamin C and DHA.

Comment NUTRIMIX & I’ll send you a link

I also appreciate that every pack has a QR code through which parents can access lab reports and check protein validation, heavy metal and mineral testing. And thankfully, the kids love the taste!

If you’re also looking for ideas to make snacking a little more nutritious, Comment SNACKS & I’ll send you a list.

#AfterSchoolSnacks #HealthySnacksForKids #VegetarianKids".

462 likes, 30 comments - mombae.blogger on October 29, 2026: "This is THE day I wait for all year! ❤️

A day when I get to dress up like a newlywed, go all out with my Solah Shringar, wear all the jewellery, adorn myself with mehendi and feel every bit of that just-married bride again. ✨

I absolutely love the rituals, the traditions and the feeling of fasting for the person you love. And this year, the day came with the sweetest surprise!

While I was fasting for him, he was fasting for me too, without telling me. I only found out much later, and honestly, nothing could have made the day more romantic. Sometimes, love is in the little things, the unspoken gestures and the thoughtfulness that takes you completely by surprise. ❤️

A day full of love, laughter, traditions, a little bit of dressing up (okay, A LOT!) and memories to cherish.

Already counting down to the next year 🥹❤️

Happy Karva Chauth! 🌙

#karwachouthspecial♥️ #karwachauthvibes❤️ #karwachauth #indiantraditions".

421 likes, 30 comments - mombae.blogger on October 21, 2026: "Shubho Bijoya! 

Born and brought up in Kolkata, Sindoor Khela has always been an integral part of my life. ❤️

As a young, unmarried girl, I would watch Bengali women dressed up in all their glory, playing with sindoor and doing Devi Boron, and I always wished I could experience it all myself someday.

Today, I’m so grateful to live in a multicultural community where every festival is celebrated with equal enthusiasm. And me being me, I love celebrating them all! ❤️

So, my annual Bengali getup is something I genuinely look forward to every year! ❤️ 

Dressing up in a traditional Bengali saree, playing sindoor, doing Devi Boron and dancing the dhunuchi naach — it brings me so much joy. There’s something incredibly comforting about it. It’s like going back to my roots and making that little girl in Kolkata happy all over again. Thank you @hoyichoyi for organising this so well.

Some traditions stay with you forever, no matter where life takes you. ❤️ Dugga Dugga!

Shubho Bijoya, everyone! শুভ বিজয়ার প্রীতি ও শুভেচ্ছা! 

Btw How do I look?

#shubhobijoya #bijoyadashami❤️ #dhunuchinach #sindoorkhela😍 #dhakbaja".

269 likes, 17 comments - mombae.blogger on October 19, 2026: "Shubh Dashami!

This Navratri… where do I even begin! ❤️ The past few days have been a complete blur!

From visiting Durga Puja pandals like I grew up doing in Kolkata (I visited 5 pandals this time), to observing 9 days of Puja the Marwari way with jot lena and jawara ugana, feeding Kanjaks the North Indian way, experiencing Golu the Tamilian way, being part of Suvasini Pujan and Oti Bharana the Maharashtrian way, and dressing up for Garba the Gujarati way… we went from one celebration to another!

And that’s what I love so much about living in Mumbai. There’s so much to experience, so many traditions to be a part of, and so much for the children to see and learn. Having grown up celebrating Durga Pujo in Kolkata, it makes me so happy that they get to experience not just our traditions but so many others too.

Between the pujas, the parties, the dancing and all the family time, the nine days just flew by. I barely managed to share as much as I wanted to on stories, and while I’m absolutely exhausted, I wouldn’t have had it any other way. ❤️

Already missing it all and wondering how we’re going to wait another 365 days for Navratri to be back! 🥹

Jai Mata Di! 🙏🏻

[Indian festival, Navratra, Ambe Ma]".

617 likes, 36 comments - mombae.blogger on October 18, 2026: "I blinked, and my Aarna is SEVEN! 🥹❤️ And that too on the most auspicious day of Ashtami.

Happy 7th birthday to my Devi Maa, my princess.

From the tiny newborn I held in my arms to the beautiful little girl I see today, I wish I could slow down time and soak in every little moment just a little longer. How did seven years pass in the blink of an eye? 🥹

If only I could freeze time, hold on to those tiny fingers a little longer, and keep you little just a little while more. But since I can’t, I’ll keep loving you through every beautiful version of you. ❤️

May Maa Durga always protect you, guide you, and fill your life with love, happiness, courage and endless blessings. 🪷🙏

Happy birthday, my princess. You will forever be my baby, no matter how big you grow. 🧿❤️

#AarnaTurns7 #kidsbirthdayreels #BirthdayGirl #Ashtami #birthdayreels".
